design: signal_c = (exceedance above the source-calibrated quantile among target flows PREDICTED c) - alpha; label-free, absolute, on the coverage scale
motivation: nb46 rank-based cannot say "all clear"; nb47 permutation-referenced flags real-but-harmless drift. Step 2 showed the operative quantity is movement AT the threshold, which this measures directly.
blind_spot: unchanged: confidently misrouted flows never enter the predicted-c set, so the label-free signal cannot see them; the signal-to-oracle gap quantifies it
power_caveat: 4 failing classes; differences below roughly 0.15 AUROC are not resolvable
